quote: For a long time that's all I had. Little moments with a girl who saw me as a friend... but I think, even then I knew, I was waiting for my wife.
You are in my very soul, tormenting me... I am in agony. The closer I get to you, the worse it gets. The thought of not being with you—I can't breathe.

The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more, that plants a fire in our hearts and brings peace to our minds. And that's what you've given me. That's what I'd hoped to give you forever.
